02.amazon_product_title: ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 R2110 Dash Camera with Built In WiFi App Support 1080P 30FPS Sony Exmor IMX323 Sensor WDR Night Vision 145 Wide Angle G Sensor Black

amazon_bullet_points: CLEAR 1080P RECORDING — Captures road footage in FHD 1080P at 30FPS with 1920×1080 video resolution.
IMPROVED NIGHT VISIBILITY — SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor with WDR Superior Night Vision helps capture details in low-light driving conditions.
WIDE ROAD COVERAGE — 145° wide-angle lens records up to 4 lanes of traffic for broader front-road visibility.
WI-FI APP ACCESS — Built-in Wi-Fi connects to the Roav Dashcam app to review, download, and share videos.
COLLISION-RESPONSIVE RECORDING — G-Sensor monitors sudden stops or collisions and instantly starts recording when triggered.

04.amazon_product_description:
The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 R2110 is a compact black dash camera designed to record clear front-road footage during everyday driving. It captures video in FHD 1080P at 30FPS with 1920×1080 resolution, helping document commutes, road trips, parking-lot incidents, sudden stops, and unexpected driving events with useful visual detail.

Built around a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor and WDR Superior Night Vision, the DashCam C1 supports improved visibility in low-light driving conditions. Its F1.8 lens uses 6 high-quality glass elements and a 145° viewing angle to record broad road coverage, including up to 4 lanes of traffic at once. The G-Sensor monitors sudden stops or collisions and instantly starts recording when triggered, adding a practical layer of event-based recording for safety and documentation.

Built-in Wi-Fi connects the camera to the Roav Dashcam app, allowing users to review, download, and share videos from a mobile device. The illuminated 2.4" screen supports on-device viewing, while the included 32GB card, Micro-USB charging cable, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, and Owner’s Manual provide the core items needed for setup and daily use. With operating temperatures from 14°F to 149°F and a 470mAh Li-polymer battery, this dashcam is built for use in a range of driving conditions.

Center the ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 as the dominant object, filling approximately 85% of the frame while keeping the entire product visible. Show the dashcam in a clean three-quarter product angle that clearly communicates it is a compact black dash camera, with the driver-facing screen, road-facing lens, lower cylindrical camera housing, top mounting plate, side circular control area, and orange accent detail visible. customer_faq.question: What comes in the box?
customer_faq.answer: The package includes the DashCam C1, Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual.

social_media_posts.caption_text: Sudden stops and unexpected driving events can happen fast. The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 records front-road footage in FHD 1080P at 30FPS, while the G-Sensor starts recording when sudden stops or collisions are detected.

Night driving can make important road details harder to capture. DashCam C1 uses a SONY Exmor IMX323 sensor with WDR Superior Night Vision and an F1.8 lens to support visibility in low-light driving conditions.

social_media_posts.caption_title: A Wider View for Daily Drives
social_media_posts.caption_text: Commuting, highway driving, and road trips all need a broader view of what is ahead. The ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 has a 145° wide-angle lens that records up to 4 lanes of traffic, plus built-in Wi-Fi for reviewing, downloading, and sharing videos through the Roav Dashcam app.

image_strategy.layout_description: Vertical 1080 × 1920 Amazon main image on pure white background. Center the ROAV by ANKER DashCam C1 as the dominant object, filling approximately 85% of the frame while keeping the entire product visible. Show the dashcam in a clean three-quarter product angle that clearly communicates it is a compact black dash camera, with the driver-facing screen, road-facing lens, lower cylindrical camera housing, top mounting plate, side circular control area, and orange accent detail visible. Arrange included accessories only if space allows without reducing product dominance: Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual placed neatly below or beside the main dashcam.
image_strategy.visual_design_direction: Professional Amazon-compliant studio product photography. Pure white RGB 255,255,255 background, realistic matte black plastic texture, glossy trim reflections, glass lens shine, subtle screen gloss, orange side accent, and soft minimal grounding shadows. No lifestyle environment, no vehicle interior, no props, no decorative elements, no badges, no callouts, no icons, and no added text or graphics.
image_strategy.image_generation_prompt: Create a realistic Amazon hero product image in vertical 9:16 format, 1080 × 1920 pixels. Use the attached reference product images to accurately depict the ROAV by ANKER DASHCAM C1, model R2110, in black. The main object is a compact dash camera with a rounded-rectangle matte black plastic body, glossy black trim, a driver-facing illuminated 2.4 inch screen, a road-facing protruding circular glass lens, a horizontal lower cylindrical camera housing, a large top mounting plate with centered mounting slot, a side circular control/button area, a small side pinhole, and a vertical orange side accent slot. Show the dashcam upright at a clean three-quarter studio product angle so the buyer immediately understands it is a dash camera. The screen should appear dark glossy and realistic, not showing UI graphics. The road-facing lens should have subtle glass reflections and appear smaller than the body but visually prominent. Keep proportions compact: wider rectangular face than depth, rounded vertical side edges, lower cylindrical lens housing, and protruding lens module. Include only the product and its included accessories if they can be shown cleanly: Anker 2-Port USB car charger, Micro-USB charging cable, 32GB card, and Owner's Manual. Accessories must be secondary and neatly arranged, not distracting from the dashcam. Product and accessories must be fully visible and centered, filling approximately 85% of the frame. Use pure white RGB 255,255,255 background with soft minimal shadows and professional studio lighting. Do not add any promotional text, overlay labels, badges, icons, feature graphics, decorative props, hands, cars, road scenes, packaging boxes, or lifestyle background. Preserve only authentic physical details visible on the product reference; do not invent new markings, colors, ports, accessories, or design elements.
